stopPoints.label: George sits happily in the shopping trolley
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): Look at George! Where is George sitting right now?
Options:
A) In the trolley 🛒
B) In the car 🚗
Guidance: Point to the shopping cart and encourage the child to say: 'In the trolley!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig says Peppa is too big for the trolley
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): Why can't Peppa sit in the trolley like George?
Options:
A) She is too big 👧
B) She is too small 👶
Guidance: Compare Peppa and George's size, and guide the child to say: 'She's too big!' or 'Peppa helps with the shopping!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa spots the red tomatoes on the shelf
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): Peppa found the tomatoes! What colour are the tomatoes on the shelf?
Options:
A) Red 🍅
B) Blue 🫐
Guidance: Point to the tomatoes on the screen and encourage the child to say: 'Red!' or 'Red tomatoes!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa counts four tomatoes into a bag
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): Peppa put the tomatoes in the bag! How many tomatoes did she count?
Options:
A) Four tomatoes 🍅🍅🍅🍅
B) One tomato 🍅
Guidance: Count the tomatoes inside the clear bag together and say: 'Four tomatoes!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa puts the pack of spaghetti into the trolley
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): Well done, Peppa! Where did Peppa put the spaghetti?
Options:
A) In the trolley 🛒
B) On the floor ⬇️
Guidance: Point to the long blue-and-yellow pack inside the cart and say: 'In the trolley!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa guesses crisps are next on the list
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): Peppa wants to buy crisps! Are crisps on the shopping list?
Options:
A) No, they aren't 🙅‍♀️
B) Yes, they are 🙆‍♀️
Guidance: Shake your head like Daddy Pig and guide the child to answer: 'No! We have plenty of crisps at home!'

stopPoints.label: George shouts Dinosaur in the supermarket
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): Haha! What funny thing does George want to buy in the supermarket?
Options:
A) A dinosaur 🦖
B) A teddy bear 🧸
Guidance: Laugh together and ask: 'Are there any dinosaurs in the supermarket? No! Encourage them to say: Dinosaur!'

stopPoints.label: Peppa counts four onions and puts them in the trolley
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): Peppa just counted four round vegetables and put them in the trolley. What are they?
Options:
A) Onions 🧅
B) Carrots 🥕
Guidance: Point to the bag of round brown onions in the trolley and say: 'Onions! Four onions!'

stopPoints.label: George chooses a very big green melon
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): Look in the trolley! Did George choose apples, oranges, bananas, or a very big melon?
Options:
A) A very big melon 🍉
B) Apples 🍏
Guidance: Point to the huge green striped fruit in the cart and encourage the child to say: 'A melon!' or 'A big green melon!'

stopPoints.label: Daddy Pig admits he put the chocolate cake in the trolley
stopPoints.question:
Question (Dialogue & Visual): Surprise at the checkout! Who secretly put the yummy chocolate cake in the trolley?
Options:
A) Daddy Pig 🐷🎂
B) Peppa Pig 👧
Guidance: Point to Daddy Pig holding the brown cake and encourage the child to laugh and say: 'Daddy Pig! Naughty Daddy!'
